No. 2372/14 – THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 22, 2024
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
,, Notice under Section 7

My Ref No.: KN/DS/PO/AQ/01. Ministry of Land's Ref No.: 4-3/4/2018/LO/489. I, hereby give notice under Sub - section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/ servitude which is required for a public purpose :
Description of the land or servitude to be acquired:
Preliminary plan : cm 920084 Situated Village : Madduvil naadu GN Division : Madduvil Naadu West (KN/66) Ds Division : Poonakary District : Kilinochchi Province : Northern

01. Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Kanavajppallam; Description: Garden, contain for permanent buildings; Claimant : Poonakary Pradeshiya Sabha; Extent: 0.4394 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid land to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat Poonakary on the 15th day of April 2024 at 9.30 a.m. and hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicates) on or before the 08th day of April 2024 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
T. A඄ංඅൺඇ, Divisional Secretary, Poonakary.
Divisional Secretariat, poonakary. 19th February, 2024 EOG 02-0154

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
,, Notice under Section 7

My Ref No.: KDS/GIK/4/4/41. Ministry of Land's Ref No.: 4/3/12/2021/CEB/192. The Land Acquisition for construction of Switchyard access road under Hydro power project of Moragolla. I, hereby give notice under Sub - section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands/ servitudes which is required for a public purpose :

Description of land or servitude to be acquired: The allotments of land called Mariyawatta Estate depicted as Lot Nos. 152 and 153 in plan No. 320740 (03) 1 prepared by Surveyor General containing in extent of 0.1501 Hectare, situated in Grama Niladhari Division of Gampolawela in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Ganga Ihalakorale in Kandy District, Central Province. Compensation Dates & Time:

Order No : 01 C.P.No : 320740 (03)1 Lot No : 152 Compensation Date : 25.03.2024 Time : 2.00 P.m. Venue : Divisional Secretariat, Ganga Ihalakorale Order No : 02 C.P.No : 320740 (03)1 Lot No : 152 Compensation Date : 25.03.2024 Time : 2.00 P.m. Venue : Divisional Secretariat, Ganga Ihalakorale

01. Lot No. 152 Name of the Land: Mariyawatta Estate; Claimant: Mr. N. Samarasinghe, No. 863, Dunhinda Road, Ethgala, Gampola; Extent: 0.0904 Hectare. North : Lot No. 145; East : Lots Nos. 145, 148 and 151; South : Lots Nos. 151 and 150; West : Lots Nos 150 and 145. 02. Lot No. 153 Name of the Land: Mariyawatta Estate; Claimant: Mr. N. Samarasinghe, No. 863, Dunhinda Road, Ethgala, Gampola; Extent: 0.0597 Hectare. North : Lot No. 144, 145 and 150; East : Lots Nos. 150, and 154; South : Lots Nos 154 and 143; West : Lots Nos. 143, 144 and 145. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/ servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me Ganga Ihalakorale Divisional Secretariat on the 25th day of March 2024 at 2.00 P.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing on or before the 04th day of march 2024 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
C.K. Aආൺඋൺ඄ඈඈඇ, Divisional Secretary, Ganga Ihalakorale,
